name: Senao International Co.,Ltd.
summary: Senao International Co.,Ltd. sells and distributes mobile handheld devices in Taiwan. The company sells mobile phones, information appliance, home appliances, peripheral products, health care, and information and communication technologies products. It also provides related repair and maintenance; and property and liability insurance agency services. The company was formerly known as Senao Business Development Company Limited and changed its name to Senao International Co., Ltd. in August 1994. Senao International Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
